name: terminal-daily-bench
_comment: Living benchmark: each day is a versioned suite (contamination-resistant). This PUBLIC bundle ships 1 sample task per split (archive/live) as a template; the full daily suites are served from the site (live suites require project-controlled protected replay, with gold+protected withheld).

suites.note: 13 certified task(s); gold withheld while live
50 certified task(s): 0 fresh + 0 carried + 50 unknown-origin; gold withheld while live

single-shot patch generation; ranked on a common subset (task generated by >=33 models, model covering >=98% of it, tasks the oracle gate proved unsolvable removed). Three models fall short of the coverage bar and are omitted: gpt-5.2-codex (462/497 generated; the rest time out with retries exhausted, and shrinking the prompt context did not help), GLM-5.2-FP8 and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B (on-prem backend, 300-1400s per call).
